# Relametric (kevin-owens-product/Relametric)

> Experimental TypeScript visualization on Three.js, with typed source adapters and example workflows linking records, evidence and decision briefs.

Working brand: Relametric. Rendering import: relametric. API: createRelametric and four RelametricLayer factories. Connector imports: relametric-connectors and relametric-connectors/server. Both packages are prepared for npm publication but still unpublished; use built local paths. Node 22.16+ for the core/site, 22.16+ for connectors. Browser scenes require WebGL2. Examples use fictional data, not demonstrated customer outcomes. Unrelated to Cylynx motif.gl.

Four foundation experiments are additional to the 100 recipes.
